name: Handful of Oats (Classic)
summary: In Westfall, Old Blanchy needs oats after the Furlbrows' wagon breaks down.

sections.title: Fodder Among the Ruins
sections.body: Westfall once fed the Kingdom of Stormwind. Now its farms lie overgrown or under the control of Defias bandits and rogue harvest golems. Sacks of grain and oats remain by barns and outbuildings, and in overgrown fields. Travelers and refugees whose wagons break down along the dusty roads can gather the leftover oats for their weary draft horses.

faq.q: What are Handfuls of Oats used for?
faq.answer: The oats feed Old Blanchy, the Furlbrow family's weary mare. Their wagon broke down on a Westfall road, leaving her exhausted and hungry.

faq.q: Where can these oats be found?
faq.answer: Oats lie in sacks scattered across abandoned Westfall farms. Look especially in the southwest.

faq.q: Why are the oat sacks left unguarded?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood rose suddenly, and rogue harvest machinery rampaged through the fields. Farmers fled in haste, leaving harvested grain and other supplies in their fields and barns.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler in Westfall, you can offer stranded refugees like the Furlbrows a small act of mercy by gathering oats on Stormwind's neglected frontier.
